- Release the engine electrical wiring from the securing bands and move it aside.
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the electronic power module (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000253.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the tappet cover (1b) complete with gaskets.
2. Unscrew the timing system hydraulic tensioner and remove.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000254.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Remove the spark plugs to facilitate the subsequent engine cranking operations.
1. Rotate the crankshaft until cylinder no. 4 is at T.D.C. in the explosion stroke; in this condition the reference (1a) on the inner part of the crankshaft pulley should be in line with the reference (1b) on the timing chain cover.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000255.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and disconnect the intermediate exhaust pipe (1b), exhaust manifold side with the catalytic converter.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000256.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the phase transformer electromagnets (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000257.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the upper timing chain tensioner pad (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000258.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Support the engine using a hydraulic hoist fitted with suitable chains attached to the brackets on the actual engine.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000259.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Undo the bolts (1a), (1b) and remove the flexible mounting for the power unit timing side front support (1c) complete with power assisted steering fluid reservoir mounting bracket (1d).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000260.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Raise the engine as necessary using the hydraulic hoist.
1. Undo the access cap to the belt tensioner pad upper fixing bolt.
- Undo the upper fixed belt tensioner fixed pad fixing bolt.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000261.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Undo the camshaft phase transformer fixing bolts.
> Note: Turn the hexagonal bolts on the camshafts using a fixed wrench to provide counter-torque.
2. Remove the camshaft phase transformers.
> Note: Secure the timing chain to prevent it falling inside the sump.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000262.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the crankshaft oil seal front cover (1b).
> Note: To remove the crankshaft front oil seal cover, move forward first to release the two locating bushes.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000263.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
> Note: The crankshaft front oil seal cover gasket does not need replacing whenever the cover is removed but only if it is damaged.
1. Remove the crankshaft front oil seal cover (1a) destructively by cutting through points (1b) shown in the figure.
> Note: The part of the gasket (1c) that remains attached to the rigid engine mount does not affect the seal. Remove the same section from the new gasket to allow installation.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000264.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Working at the bench, remove the oil seal from the timing chain cover.
> Note: Take care not to damage the sealing surfaces (of the timing chain cover) during the "destructive" removal of the oil seal.
1. Undo the lower bolt (1a) and remove the timing fixed tensioner pad (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000265.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Undo the belt tensioner mobile pad fixing bolt.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000266.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Release the timing chain from the toothed drive pulley.
1. Remove the mobile chain tensioner pad.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000267.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Remove the timing chain.

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Refitting
- Tighten the plug for access to the upper bolt securing the chain tensioner fixed pad.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cap for timing fixed chain tensioner pad upper bolt | - | M22 | 6.5 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
1. Place the inlet side camshaft phase transformer (1a) in its housing and secure it using a new bolt (1b) without tightening it.
2. Turn the crankshaft until cylinder 4 is at TDC in the combustion phase, white notch stamped on the timing chain toothed drive pulley turned down and key upward.
> Note: Rotate the crankshaft slowly and evenly (in the direction of rotation).
> Note: Ensure the timing chain is not stuck.
3. Fit the timing chain.
> Note: The pink link (3a) should be aligned with the white notch stamped on the timing chain toothed drive pulley.
> Note: The light blue mesh (3b) should be in line with the reference (3c) on the inlet side camshaft phase transformer.
4. Place the exhaust side camshaft phase transformer (4a) in its housing and secure it using a new bolt (4b) without tightening it.
> Note: Rotate the exhaust side camshaft using the hexagon until the pink mesh (4c) is in line with the reference (4d) on the exhaust side camshaft phase transformer.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000270.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- The following drawing shows the fixed timing chain hydraulic tensioner disassembled.
> Note: Replace the seals.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000271.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Before it is possible to refit the timing fixed hydraulic tensioner it must be pre-loaded as described below.
1. Position the piston in a vice with protective jaws, holding it by the square end.
2. Insert the piston into the tensioner case by pressing and turning as shown in the figure until the pin (2a) fits into the groove (2b).
3. Press and simultaneously turn the piston until the pin (3a) fits into the groove (3b).
- Insert the assembled piston into the tensioner body.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000272.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Refit the timing chain hydraulic tensioner into its seat and tighten to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Timing fixed hydraulic tensioner | - | M27 | 7.5 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000273.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Move the timing chain hydraulic tensioner to operating position by exercising overall pressure by hand on the chain in the area shown in the figure. This puts the chain under tension, which in turn acts on the mobile pad to release the mobile tensioner piston.
> Note: When the piston is activated the spring will make a noise.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000274.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
> Note: If the chain remains slack, the tensioner is not in the operating position.
- Rotate the crankshaft through 720°, then turn the crankshaft until cylinder 4 is at TDC in the combustion phase, white notch stamped on the timing chain toothed drive pulley turned down and key upward.
> Note: When the crankshaft is rotated the tensioner piston should follow the chain during the rotation stage.
- Check the timing making sure that the timing references correspond.
1. Place the upper timing chain pad (1a) in its housing and fasten it tightening the bolts (1b) to the recommended torque.

## 1032C33 TIMING SYSTEM FIXED HYDRAULIC TENSIONER - R R  [939010465]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1032 TIMING SYSTEM > 1032C TIMING SYSTEM TENSIONERS > 1032C33 TIMING SYSTEM FIXED HYDRAULIC TENSIONER - R R
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010465

##### Removing
- Position the vehicle on a lift.
Op. 1048A28 VACUUM AIR CIRCUIT RESONATOR PIPE - R+R [→939010516]
Op. 1008B10 POWER UNIT FRONT SUPPORT FLEXIBLE MOUNTING (TIMING SIDE) - REPLACE [→939010409]
1. Unscrew the timing system fixed hydraulic tensioner and remove it.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000285.jpg]

1. If no mark (1b) is present on the fixed timing chain hydraulic tensioner (1a), replace the tensioner with a new unit including a new mobile chain tensioner pad.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000286.jpg]

- The following drawing shows the fixed timing chain hydraulic tensioner disassembled.
> Note: Replace the o-rings.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000287.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Before refitting, the timing chain fixed hydraulic tensioner must be preloaded as described below.
1. Position the piston in a vice with protective jaws, holding by the square end.
2. Insert the piston into the tensioner case by pressing and turning as shown in the figure until the pin (2a) fits into the groove (2b).
3. Press and simultaneously turn the piston until pin (3a) fits into groove (3b).
- Insert the assembled piston into the tensioner body.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000288.jpg]

1. Refit the timing chain fixed hydraulic tensioner into its seat and tighten to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Timing fixed hydraulic tensioner | - | M27 | 7.5 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000289.jpg]

Op. 4450B04 RIGHT FRONT WHEEL - R.R [→939010872]
Op. 7055B66 ENGINE COMPARTMENT DUST COVER IN RIGHT FRONT WHEEL ARCH - R.R. [→939004938]
1. Move the timing system hydraulic tensioner to operating position by turning the crankshaft pulley (1a) quickly anticlockwise using tool (1b).
| Tool | Description | Function | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2000001000 | Counter-torque | Loosen/ tighten bolt securing crankshaft pulley | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000290.jpg]

Op. 7055B66 ENGINE COMPARTMENT DUST COVER IN RIGHT FRONT WHEEL ARCH - R.R. [→939004938]
Op. 4450B04 RIGHT FRONT WHEEL - R.R [→939010872]
Op. 1008B10 POWER UNIT FRONT SUPPORT FLEXIBLE MOUNTING (TIMING SIDE) - REPLACE [→939010409]
Op. 1048A28 VACUUM AIR CIRCUIT RESONATOR PIPE - R+R [→939010516]
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.

Op. 1032B40 TOOTHED DRIVEN PULLEY (ONE) - R + R WITH TIMING BELT REMOVED [→939010459]

Op. 3330D30 VACUUM PUMP - R+R [→939010804]
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the camshaft bearings lubrication pipe (1b).
2. Undo the bolts (2a) and remove the camshaft caps (2b).
3. Remove the camshaft (3a) complete with oil seal (3b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/199002077.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Fit the camshaft in the housing in the cylinder head.
- Place the camshaft caps in their housings.
- Place the camshaft bearings lubrication pipe in its housing.
- Tighten the bolts fixing the camshaft caps to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Camshaft caps | Bolt | M7 | 1.3 ÷ 1.6 | 1.9 Multijet |
1. Fit a new oil seal (1b) on the camshaft using the tool (1a).
| Tool | Description | Function | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1860824000 | Fitting tool | Fitting camshaft front oil seal | 1.9 Multijet |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/199002078.jpg]

## 1036C OVERHEAD CAMSHAFTS (2) IN CYLINDER HEAD (1)  [939010472]

## 1036C10 CAMSHAFTS IN CAMSHAFT HOUSING - R.R - INCLUDES CAMSHAFT HOUSING REPLACEMENT, IF NECESSARY  [939010473]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1036 TIMING SYSTEM > 1036C OVERHEAD CAMSHAFTS (2) IN CYLINDER HEAD (1) > 1036C10 CAMSHAFTS IN CAMSHAFT HOUSING - R.R - INCLUDES CAMSHAFT HOUSING REPLACEMENT, IF NECESSARY
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010473

##### Removing
- Make sure that the ignition key is in the OFF position, then disconnect the battery terminal (-).
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| - | Battery | See A001 BATTERY [→939004879] |
Op. 1048A28 VACUUM AIR CIRCUIT RESONATOR PIPE - R+R [→939010516]
- Using a suitable syringe, draw off the power assisted steering fluid from the reservoir.
1. Undo the connector (1a) and disconnect the supply pipe from the pump to the power assisted steering box (1b), power assisted steering pump side.
2. Loosen the band and disconnect the supply pipe from the fluid reservoir to the power assisted steering pump, power assisted steering pump side.
3. Loosen the band and disconnect the return pipe from the heat exchanger to the power assisted steering fluid reservoir, reservoir side.
4. Undo the bolts (4a) and remove the power assisted steering fluid reservoir (4b) complete with pipe (4c).
5. Loosen the band and disconnect the coolant return pipe, cylinder head side.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000294.jpg]

1. Disconnect the electrical connections (1a) and (1b) from the phase transformer electromagnets.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1a | Exhaust side phase transformer solenoid valve | See N093 PHASE SHIFTER SOLENOID VALVE ON EXHAUST SIDE [→939004486] |
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1b | Inlet side phase transformer solenoid valve | See N092 PHASE SHIFTER SOLENOID VALVE ON INTAKE SIDE [→939004484] |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000295.jpg]

1. Disconnect the electrical connections (1a) and (1b) from the cam angle sensors.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1a | Exhaust side timing sensor | See K107 EXHAUST SIDE TIMING SENSOR [→939004259] |
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1b | Inlet side timing sensor | See K106 INTAKE SIDE TIMING SENSOR [→939004257] |
2. Disconnect the electrical connections from the electronic power module.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | Ignition coil | See A030 IGNITION COIL [→939003625] |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000296.jpg]

1. Disconnect the electrical connection from the engine coolant temperature sensor.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Engine coolant temperature sensor/sender unit | See K036 ENGINE COOLANT TEMPERATURE SENSOR/SENDER UNIT [→939004185] |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000297.jpg]

- Release the engine electrical wiring from the securing bands and move it aside.
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the electronic power module (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000298.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the tappet cover (1b) complete with gaskets.
2. Unscrew the timing system hydraulic tensioner and remove it.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000299.jpg]

1. If no mark (1b) is present on the fixed timing chain hydraulic tensioner (1a), replace the tensioner with a new unit including a new mobile chain tensioner pad.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000300.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and disconnect the intermediate exhaust pipe (1b), exhaust manifold side with the catalytic converter.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000301.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the phase transformer electromagnets (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000302.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the upper timing chain tensioner pad (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000303.jpg]

1. Support the engine using a hydraulic hoist fitted with suitable chains attached to the brackets on the actual engine.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000304.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a), (1b) and remove the flexible mounting for the power unit timing side front support (1c) complete with power assisted steering fluid reservoir mounting bracket (1d).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000305.jpg]

- Raise the engine as necessary using the hydraulic hoist.
1. Undo the access cap to the fixed belt tensioner pad upper fixing bolt.
- Undo the upper fixed belt tensioner fixed pad fixing bolt.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000306.jpg]

1. Undo the camshaft phase transformer fixing bolts.
> Note: Turn the hexagonal bolts on the camshafts to provide countertorque.
2. Remove the camshaft phase transformers.
> Note: Secure the timing chain appropriately.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000307.jpg]

Op. 1056F76 HIGH PRESSURE PIPE FROM PRESSURE PUMP TO SINGLE FUEL MANIFOLD PIPE R R [→939010540]
1. Disconnect the rapid connector for the fuel supply pipe, pressure pump side.
2. Undo the bolts (2a) and remove the pressure pump (2b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000308.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the inlet side camshaft caps (1b).
> Note: Gradually loosen the camshaft cap bolts by half/one turn in the sequence shown in the figure. The camshaft should come away evenly from its seats.
2. Remove the intake side camshaft.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000309.jpg]

- Repeat these operations for the exhaust side camshaft.

##### Refitting
> Note: If the camshafts are replaced, also replace the rockers.
1. Replace the intake side camshaft in its housing.
> Note: Moisten the sliding surfaces with MoS2 lubricant paste (grey)
2. Place the inlet side camshaft caps (2a) in their housings and secure them tightening the bolts (2b) to the recommended torque.
> Note: Position the camshaft caps in accordance with the stamps shown in the diagram.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Camshaft rear caps | Bolt | M6 | (cylinder head side) 0.7 - 0.9 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Camshaft front/ intermediate caps | Bolt | M8 | (cylinder head side) 1.8 - 2.2 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000310.jpg]

- Repeat these operations for the exhaust side camshaft.
- Tighten the upper bolt fixing the fixed belt tensioner pad to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Timing fixed chain tensioner pad | Upper bolt | M6 | (cylinder head side) 0.8 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
1. Tighten the access cap to the belt tensioner pad upper fixing bolt to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cap for timing fixed chain tensioner pad upper bolt | - | M22 | 6.5 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000311.jpg]

1. Place the inlet side camshaft phase transformer (1a) in its housing and secure it using a new bolt (1b) without tightening it.
2. If necessary, rotate the crankshaft until cylinder no. 4 is at T.D.C. in the explosion stroke; in this condition the reference (2a) on the inner part of the crankshaft pulley should be in line with the reference (2b) on the timing chain cover.
> Note: Rotate the crankshaft slowly and evenly (in the direction of rotation).
> Note: Ensure the timing chain is not stuck.
3. Fit the timing chain on the inlet side camshaft phase transformer.
> Note: The light blue mesh (3a) should be in line with the reference (3b) on the inlet side camshaft phase transformer.
4. Place the exhaust side camshaft phase transformer (4a) in its housing and secure it using a new bolt (4b) without tightening it.
> Note: Rotate the exhaust side camshaft using the hexagon until the pink mesh (4c) is in line with the reference (4d) on the exhaust side camshaft phase transformer.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000312.jpg]

- The following drawing shows the fixed timing chain hydraulic tensioner disassembled.
> Note: Replace the seals.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000313.jpg]

- Before it is possible to refit the timing fixed hydraulic tensioner it must be pre-loaded as described below.
1. Place the piston in a vice with protective jaws, holding by the square end.
2. Insert the piston into the tensioner case by pressing and turning as shown in the figure until the pin (2a) fits into the groove (2b).
3. Press and simultaneously turn the piston until the pin (3a) fits into the groove (3b).
- Insert the assembled piston into the tensioner body.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000314.jpg]

1. Refit the timing chain hydraulic tensioner into its seat and tighten to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Timing fixed hydraulic tensioner | - | M27 | 7.5 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000315.jpg]

1. Move the timing chain hydraulic tensioner to operating position by exercising overall pressure by hand on the chain in the area shown in the figure. This puts the chain under tension, which in turn acts on the mobile pad to release the mobile tensioner piston.
> Note: When the piston is activated the spring will make a noise.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000316.jpg]

> Note: If the chain remains slack, the tensioner is not in the operating position.
- Rotate the crankshaft through 720°, then place cylinder no. 4 at T.D.C. during the explosion stroke; in this condition the reference on the inner part of the crankshaft pulley should be aligned with the reference on the timing chain cover.
> Note: When the crankshaft is rotated the tensioner piston should follow the chain during the rotation stage.
- Check the timing making sure that the timing references correspond.
1. Place the upper timing chain upper pad (1a) in its housing and fasten it tightening the bolts (1b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Timing upper chain tensioner pad | Bolt | M6 | (cylinder head side) 1.0 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000317.jpg]

1. Tighten the bolts fixing the camshaft phase transformers to the recommended torque tightening the exhaust side phase transformer bolt first.
> Note: Turn the hexagonal bolts on the camshafts to provide countertorque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Camshaft phase transformers | Bolt | M11 | (camshaft side) 9.0 - 11.0 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000318.jpg]

1. Position the pressure pump (1a) in its housing and secure it tightening the bolts (1b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pressure pump | Bolt | M6 | 1.0 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
2. Connect the rapid connector for the fuel supply pipe, pressure pump side.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000319.jpg]

Op. 1056F76 HIGH PRESSURE PIPE FROM PRESSURE PUMP TO SINGLE FUEL MANIFOLD PIPE R R [→939010540]
1. Place the timing side power unit front support flexible mounting (1a) in its housing complete with power assisted steering fluid reservoir mounting bracket (1b) and secure it tightening the bolts (1c) and (1d) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Timing side power unit rigid support flexible mounting | Bolt (to be replaced) | M12 | (rigid support side) 6.3 - 7.7 + 90° |  |
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Timing side power unit rigid support flexible mounting | Bolt (to be replaced) | M12 | (bodyshell side) 6.3 - 7.7 + 90° |  |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000320.jpg]

- Remove the hydraulic hoist fitted with suitable chains for supporting the engine.
1. Place the phase transformer electromagnets (1a) in their housings and secure them tightening the bolts (1b) to the recommended torque.
> Note: The white phase transformer electromagnet is the inlet side one and the black phase transformer electromagnet is the exhaust side one.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Phase transformer solenoids | Bolt | M6 | (cylinder head side) 1.0 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS 3.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000321.jpg]

1. Connect the intermediate exhaust pipe (1b), exhaust manifold side with the catalytic converter and tighten the bolts (1b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Intermediate exhaust pipe with flexible section | Bolt | M8 | (exhaust manifold side with catalytic converter) 2.2 - 2.6 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000322.jpg]

1. Place the tappet cover (1a) complete with gaskets in its housing and secure it tightening the bolts (1b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tappet cover | Bolt | M6 | (cylinder head side) 0.7 - 0.9 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000323.jpg]

1. Place the electronic power module (1a) in its housing and secure it tightening the bolts (1b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ignition coil module | Bolt | M6 | (tappet cover side) 2.2 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000324.jpg]

- Place the engine electrical wiring in position and fasten it with the bands.
- Connect the electrical connection to the engine coolant temperature sensor.
- Connect the electrical connections to the electronic power module.
- Connect the electrical connections to the cam angle sensors.
- Connect the electrical connections to the phase transformer electromagnets.
- Connect the coolant return pipe, cylinder head side, and tighten the band.
- Place the power assisted steering fluid reservoir complete with pipe in its housing and secure it using the bolts.
- Connect the return pipe from the heat exchanger to the power assisted steering fluid reservoir, reservoir side and tighten the band.
- Connect the supply pipe from the fluid reservoir to the power assisted steering pump, power assisted steering pump side, and tighten the band.
- Connect the supply pipe from the pump to the power assisted steering box , power assisted steering pump side, and tighten the connector to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Supply pipe from pump to power assisted steering box | Connector | M16 | (power assisted steering pump side) 3.6 - 4.4 |  |
Op. 1048A28 VACUUM AIR CIRCUIT RESONATOR PIPE - R+R [→939010516]
- Connect the negative battery terminal.
Op. 0010T71 POWER STEERING FLUID CHECK LEVEL AND TOP UP IF NECESSARY [→939010377]

## 1036H56 HYDRAULIC TAPPET (ONE) AND VALVE CONTROL ROCKER (ONE) - R R WITH CAMSHAFT REMOVED  [939010477]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1036 TIMING SYSTEM > 1036H TAPPETS AND ROCKER SHAFTS > 1036H56 HYDRAULIC TAPPET (ONE) AND VALVE CONTROL ROCKER (ONE) - R R WITH CAMSHAFT REMOVED
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010477

##### Removing
1. Remove the rocker controlling the relevant valve.
2. Remove the associated hydraulic tappet.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000325.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Lubricate the hydraulic tappet with engine oil and replace in its seat.
- Lubricate the valve control rocker with engine oil and replace in its seat.
> Note: If the valve control rockers are replaced, the camshafts must also be replaced.

## 1036H14 VALVE TAPPETS - CHECK CLEARANCE  [939010480]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1036 TIMING SYSTEM > 1036H TAPPETS AND ROCKER SHAFTS > 1036H14 VALVE TAPPETS - CHECK CLEARANCE
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010480

Op. 1016A10 SOUND-PROOFING COVER - R.R [→939010416]
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the cam cover (1b) complete with gasket.
2. Using a feeler gauge, measure the clearance between the camshaft and a tappet shim.
> Note: Rotate the camshaft using the drive pulley nut and check the clearance for all the tappets,
| Measurement | Value | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Inlet valves clearance in closed position | 0.25 - 0.35 mm | 1.9 JTD 8v |
| Measurement | Value | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Exhaust valves clearance in closed position | 0.30 - 0.40 mm | 1.9 JTD 8v |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003371.jpg]

- Place the tappet cover complete with gasket back in its housing and secure it by tightening the bolts to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tappet cover | Bolt | M6 | (cylinder head side) 0.8 - 1.0 | 1.9 JTD 8v |

> Block applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Disconnect the rapid connector (1a) connecting the fuel filler pipe to the tank using the tool (1b).
| Tool | Description | Function | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2000010500 | Caliper | Disconnect/ connect the fuel inlet pipe rapid connector |  |
- Work in a similar fashion to disconnect the breather pipe.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946000337.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Refitting
- Place the fuel filler pipe together with the breather pipe in the housing.
- Connect the two pipes to the fuel tank connectors.
- Fasten the two pipes to the bodyshell tightening the bracket.
- Place the tank mounting bracket in position and secure it using the nut.
- Place the tank heat shield in position and fasten it to the tank mounting bracket.
- Connect the fuel filler pipe upper flange to the bodyshell and secure it using the bolts.
- Tighten the fuel filler pipe cap.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fuel tank | Bolt | M8 | (bodyshell side) 3.2 - 3.9 |  |
- Remove the hydraulic jack with the suitable tool for supporting the fuel tank.
- Connect the rapid connector for the rear fuel supply pipe, submerged pump assembly side complete with level gauge.
- Place the access cover to the submerged pump assembly complete with level gauge back in its housing and secure it using the bolts.

1. Undo the fixing nuts and move the engine coolant reservoir to one side.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946000350.jpg]

1. Disconnect the rapid connector for the fuel return pipe from the three-way connector.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946000351.jpg]

- Undo the fastenings and remove the electrical connections protection.
1. Disconnect the electrical connection for the left head catalyzer Lambda sensor.

| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Lambda sensor on catalyzer 2 | See K018 LAMBDA SENSOR ON CATALYZER - 2 [→939004160] |
2. Disconnect the electrical connection for the right head catalyzer Lambda sensor.

| --- | --- | --- |

1. Undo the bolts and remove the front section of the exhaust from the left head precatalyzer.

[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946000354.jpg]

1. Release the fuel return pipe from the underbody fastenings and remove it.

- Place the catalyzer assembly and gaskets in position and connect it to the two front exhaust pipes using the fixing nuts.
- Connect the electrical connections for the two Lambda sensors and fit the guard.
- Place the engine coolant reservoir on its bracket and secure it using the nuts.

## 1044B10 FUEL FILTER ASSEMBLY - R + R OR REPLACE  [939010509]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1044 FUEL CIRCUIT PUMP/S AND DEVICES > 1044B FUEL FILTERS > 1044B10 FUEL FILTER ASSEMBLY - R + R OR REPLACE
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010509

##### Removing
- Make sure that the ignition key is in the OFF position, then disconnect the battery terminal (-).
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| - | Battery | See A001 BATTERY [→939004879] |
1. Disconnect the rapid connectors from the fuel filter, fuel filter side.
2. Unscrew nut (2a) and open fuel filter bracket (2b).
3. Raise the fuel filter assembly (3a) by the required amount and disconnect the electrical connection (3b) from the water presence sensor, then remove.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3b | Fuel temperature and water in fuel filter sensor | See K101 FUEL TEMPERATURE AND WATER IN FUEL FILTER SENSOR [→939004255] |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001463.jpg]

1. Working at the bench, unscrew the water presence sensor in the fuel filter and remove.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001464.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Refit the water sensor in its seat on the fuel filter.
- Connect the electrical connection to the water presence sensor, then refit the fuel filter assembly in its seat.
- Secure with fuel filter with its bracket and tighten the nut.
- Connect the rapid connectors for the fuel pipes, fuel filter side.
- Connect the negative battery terminal.

## 1048A63 HOSE CONNECTING RESONATOR, FLOW METER AND THROTTLE BODY - R.R.  [939005264]

- Applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005264

##### Removing
1. Undo the nut (1a) fixing the bracket (1b) integrated with the air hose (1c).
2. Loosen the band securing the air hose (1c) to the throttle body.
3. Loosen the band (3a) and disconnect the oil vapour recovery pipe (3b) from the air hose (1c).
4. Loosen the band (4a) and disconnect the hose (4b) from the resonator.
5. Loosen the band and remove the air hose (1c) from the flow meter.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946001152.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Connect the air hose to the flow meter and secure it using the band.
- Connect the hose to the resonator and secure it using the band.
- Connect the oil vapour pipe to the air hose and secure with the band.
- Tighten the band securing the air hose to the throttle body.
- Tighten the nut securing the bracket integrated with the air hose.

## 1056B82 INJECTION/IGNITION SYSTEM E.C.U. (ONE) - R + R  [939005841]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1056 PETROL INJECTION SYSTEM > 1056B MULTI-POINT INJECTION SYSTEM (MPI) > 1056B82 INJECTION/IGNITION SYSTEM E.C.U. (ONE) - R + R
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.8; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005841

##### Removing
> Note: The injection-ignition system control unit is a component that is sensitive to electrostatic interference. Do not touch the injection-ignition system control unit once the engine is started unless the static electricity has been discharged first by touching the bodyshell.
1. Disconnect the electrical connections for the injection/ignition system control unit.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Engine management control unit | See M010 ENGINE MANAGEMENT ECU [→939004314] |
2. Undo the bolt and release the earth lead from the control unit.
3. Undo the bolts (3a) and remove the injection/ignition system control unit (3b).
> Note: The rear bolt on the engine coolant reservoir side also secures the earth lead.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194005251.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Place the injection/ignition system control unit in its housing and secure it tightening the bolts to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Injection/ignition system control unit | Bolt | M6 | 0.8 ÷ 1.0 | 1.8 |
- Connect the earth lead and secure it using the bolt.
- Connect the electrical connections for the injection/ignition system control unit.

## 1056F61 LEFT CYLINDER HEAD FUEL MANIFOLD PIPE - R.R.  [939005270]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1056 PETROL INJECTION SYSTEM > 1056F PETROL DIRECT INJECTION SYSTEM > 1056F61 LEFT CYLINDER HEAD FUEL MANIFOLD PIPE - R.R.
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005270

##### Removing
Op. 1056F74 LOW PRESSURE PIPE TO FUEL PRESSURE PUMP R R [→939010539]
Op. 1056F76 HIGH PRESSURE PIPE FROM PRESSURE PUMP TO SINGLE FUEL MANIFOLD PIPE R R [→939010540]
Op. 1072B50 AIR CHAMBER - R.R. [→939010591]
1. Loosen the connector for the fuel return pipe, pressure pump side and place it to one side.
2. Loosen the band and disconnect the fuel vapour pipe from the pressure pump.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946001163.jpg]

1. Remove the adhesive tape securing the injector wiring to the fuel manifold pipe for the left cylinder head.
2. Undo the bolts (2a) securing the fuel manifold pipe for the left cylinder head (2b).
3. Undo the bolts (3a) securing the fuel manifold pipe for the right cylinder head (3b).
4. Disconnect the electrical connection for the fuel pressure sensor.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 | Fuel pressure sensor | See K083 FUEL PRESSURE SENSOR [→939004238] |
- Remove the fuel manifold pipe for the left cylinder head (2b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946001164.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Lubricate the O-rings on the injectors with engine oil.
- Fit the retaining clips that may have been removed during the removal of the fuel distribution manifold on the injectors.
- Fit the fuel distribution manifold for the left head on the injectors.
> Note: Take great care not to damage the O-rings for the injectors during the fitting of the fuel distribution manifold.
- Secure the injectors to the fuel distribution manifold for the left cylinder head using the retaining clips.
- Definitively secure the two fuel distribution manifolds to the cylinder heads tightening the bolts to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fuel manifold pipe | Bolt | - | 1.0 | 3.2 JTS |
- Connect the electrical connection for the fuel pressure sensor.
- Connect the fuel vapour pipe to the pressure pump and secure it using the band.
- Place the fuel return pipe in its housing and tighten the connector to the pressure pump.
Op. 1072B50 AIR CHAMBER - R.R. [→939010591]
Op. 1056F76 HIGH PRESSURE PIPE FROM PRESSURE PUMP TO SINGLE FUEL MANIFOLD PIPE R R [→939010540]
Op. 1056F74 LOW PRESSURE PIPE TO FUEL PRESSURE PUMP R R [→939010539]
- Check for any fuel leaks in the area where the injectors-distribution manifolds for the left and right cylinder heads are connected following the instructions in test 1056BA.

Op. 1056F74 LOW PRESSURE PIPE TO FUEL PRESSURE PUMP R R [→939010539]

## 1056F73 FUEL VAPOUR RECOVERY PIPE - R.R.  [939005274]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1056 PETROL INJECTION SYSTEM > 1056F PETROL DIRECT INJECTION SYSTEM > 1056F73 FUEL VAPOUR RECOVERY PIPE - R.R.
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005274

##### Removing
1. Loosen the band (1a) and disconnect the fuel vapour recovery pipe (1b), pressure pump side.
2. Disconnect the rapid connector (2a) for the fuel vapour recovery pipe (2b), three-way connector side.
3. Loosen the band and disconnect the fuel vapour recovery pipe, solenoid valve side.
- Remove the fuel vapour recovery pipe.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946001169.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Place the fuel vapour recovery pipe in position.
- Connect the fuel vapour recovery pipe, solenoid valve side and secure it using the band.
- Connect the rapid connector for the fuel vapour recovery pipe, three-way connector side.
- Connect the fuel vapour recovery pipe, pressure pump side and secure it using the band.

1. Detach the electrical connection from the exhaust side timing sensor.

1. Undo the nut securing the fuel pipes to the mounting bracket.
2. Undo the nut securing the fuel pipes mounting bracket.
3. Disconnect the rapid connector and open the fuel tank connection pipe retaining clip, three-way connector side.
4. Undo the connector for the pipe from the pump to the single fuel manifold, pressure pump side.
5. Disconnect the rapid connector for the fuel supply pipe to the pressure pump, pressure pump side.
6. Undo connectors (6a) for the delivery and return pipes, single fuel manifold side, and remove the high and low pressure fuel pipe assembly (6b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005648.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Place the high and low pressure fuel pipe assembly back in position and tighten the connectors attaching it to the single fuel manifold and the pressure pump.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| High pressure pipe from pressure pump to fuel manifold pipe | Connector | M10 | (pressure pump side) 1.7 - 2.3 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Low pressure pipe to fuel pressure pump | Connector | M12 | (fuel manifold side) 1.7 - 2.3 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
- Tighten the nuts securing the brackets to the pressure pump and the tappet cover.
- Connect the rapid connector for the fuel supply pipe to the pressure pump, pressure pump side.
- Connect the rapid connector and close the fuel tank connection pipe retaining clip, three-way connector side.
- Secure the electrical wiring with the band.
- Attach the electrical connection to the fuel pressure regulator on the air intake/fuel manifold duct.
- Secure the electrical connection for the exhaust side timing sensor.

- Release the system cable loom from the fastenings and remove it.

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Refitting
- Place the system cable loom in its housing and secure it.
- Connect the electrical connection for the detonation sensor.
- Connect the electrical connections to the injectors.
- Connect the electrical connection for the engine rpm sensor.
- Connect the electrical connection to the engine oil pressure warning light switch.
- Connect the earth lead to the alternator and tighten the nut.
- Connect the electrical connection to the air conditioning compressor.
- Connect the electrical connection to the air flow meter.
- Connect the electrical connections to the phase transformer electromagnets.
- Connect the electrical connection to the engine coolant temperature sensor.
- Connect the electrical connection to the fuel pressure sensor.
- Connect the electrical connection to the fuel pressure regulator on the air intake/fuel manifold duct.
- Connect the electrical connections to the electronic power module.
- Connect the electrical connections to the cam angle sensors.
- Connect the electrical connection to the electronic injection system control unit.
- Connect the electrical connections and close the junction unit cover.
- Place the ignition coil cover back in its housing and tighten the bolts.

## 1060D38 SWITCH ON BRAKE PEDAL - R.R (DIESEL ENGINES)  [939010546]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1060 DIESEL INJECTION SYSTEM > 1060D ELECTRONIC DIESEL INJECTION PUMP CONTROL > 1060D38 SWITCH ON BRAKE PEDAL - R.R (DIESEL ENGINES)
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010546

##### Removing
1. Disconnect the electrical connection.
| Description | Component |
| --- | --- |
| BRAKE PEDAL SWITCH | See I030 BRAKE PEDAL SWITCH [→939004116] |
2. Rotate the switch on the brake pedal (2a) through about 90° in an anti-clockwise and extract it from the mounting (2b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001469.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Check that the switch is not damaged.
- Gently lower the brake pedal and fit the switch in place, then rotate it through about 90° in a clockwise direction until it is locked.
- Connect the electrical connection.
- Check that the brake lights are working.

Op. 1016A10 SOUND-PROOFING COVER - R.R [→939010416]
- Clean the high pressure pump using cold cleaning products and dry with compressed air.
> Note: The cold washing products should not penetrate inside the electrical connection.
Op. 1060F20 PIPE FROM PRESSURE PUMP TO FUEL MANIFOLD - R.R. [→939010561]
1. Loosen the band and disconnect the outlet pipe from the engine oil vapour separator.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001485.jpg]

1. Disconnect the electrical connection for the fuel pressure regulator.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Fuel pressure regulator | See N077 FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR [→939004464] |
2. Undo the bolts fixing the fuel pressure regulator.
> Note: Check that the fixing bolts are not damaged otherwise they have to be replaced. Fixing bolts that are not damaged can be reused.
3. Manually rotate the pressure regulator in its housing in an anti-clockwise direction and remove it.
> Note: Do not use any tools for removing the fuel pressure regulator from the pressure pump.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001486.jpg]

- Remove any dirt from the pressure pump opening or in the spaces on the surface.

##### Refitting
1. Before fitting the fuel pressure regulator, check that the green seal (1a) and the black seal (1b) are intact and correctly housed.
> Note: If they are damaged, always replace the seals and the fixing bolts.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001487.jpg]

- Lubricate the seals with clean diesel fuel.
- Place the pressure regulator in its housing on the pressure pump.
- Manually rotate the fuel pressure regulator in an anti-clockwise direction and press until the matching surfaces are in contact.
- Position the fuel pressure regulator correctly.
> Note: Do not use any tools for placing the fuel pressure regulator back in its housing.
- Tighten the bolts fixing the fuel pressure regulator to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fuel pressure regulator | Bolt | M | (pressure pump side) 0.6 - 0.7 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V 2.4 JTD 20V |
- Connect the electrical connection to the fuel pressure regulator.
- Connect the outlet pipe to the engine oil vapour separator and tighten the band.
Op. 1060F20 PIPE FROM PRESSURE PUMP TO FUEL MANIFOLD - R.R. [→939010561]
Op. 1016A10 SOUND-PROOFING COVER - R.R [→939010416]
- Connect the negative battery terminal.

##### Removing

Op. 1060F36 PIPES (ALL) FROM FUEL MANIFOLD TO INJECTOR - R.R. [→939010557]
1. Undo the injector bracket retaining nuts.
2. Remove the injectors (2a) complete with brackets using the tools (2b).
> Note: If a new injector/new inectors are fitted:- determine the identification code stamped on the top surface;- check, using an Examiner, the the new injector(s) is (are) recognized by the engine management control unit.
> Note: Start the removal beginning with the injector for cylinder no. 1 and continue with the injectors for cylinders 2, 3 and 4.
| Tool | Description | Function | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

> Note: Start refitting beginning with the injector for cylinder no. 4 and continue with the injectors for cylinders 3, 2 and 1.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Injector brackets | Nut | M8 | (cylinder head extension side) 2.3 - 2.8 | 1.9 JTD 16v 2.4 JTD 20v |
Op. 1060F36 PIPES (ALL) FROM FUEL MANIFOLD TO INJECTOR - R.R. [→939010557]
- Connect the electrical connections to the injectors.

## 1060F50 FUEL RETURN MANIFOLD - R.R.  [939010558]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1060 DIESEL INJECTION SYSTEM > 1060F INJECTORS AND PIPES > 1060F50 FUEL RETURN MANIFOLD - R.R.
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010558

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
##### Removing
Op. 1016A10 SOUND-PROOFING COVER - R.R [→939010416]
1. Disconnect the rapid connector for the fuel return pipe to the tank, fuel return manifold side.
2. Loosen the bands and remove the fuel return pipe from the fuel manifold, fuel return manifold side.
3. Disconnect the fuel return pipe from the injectors, fuel return manifold side.
4. Loosen the band and disconnect the fuel return pipe from the pressure pump, fuel return manifold pipe side.
5. Undo the bolts (5a) and remove the fuel return manifold (5b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194004376.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
##### Refitting
- Place the fuel return manifold pipe in its housing and secure it using the bolts.
- Connect the fuel return pipe to the pressure pump, fuel return manifold pipe side and tighten the band.
- Connect the fuel return pipe from the injectors, fuel return manifold side.
- Connect the fuel return pipe from the fuel manifold, fuel return manifold side and tighten the band.
- Connect the rapid connector for the fuel return pipe to the tank, fuel return manifold side.
Op. 1016A10 SOUND-PROOFING COVER - R.R [→939010416]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V; all production periods
##### Removing
Op. 1016A10 SOUND-PROOFING COVER - R.R [→939010416]
1. Disconnect the rapid connector for the fuel return pipe to the tank, fuel return manifold side.
2. Disconnect the fuel return pipe from the injectors, fuel return manifold side.
3. Tighten the bolts fixing the fuel return manifold.
4. Loosen the band and disconnect the fuel return pipe from the pressure pump, fuel return manifold pipe side.
5. Loosen the collar and disconnect the fuel return pipe from the fuel manfold pipe, fuel return manifold side.
6. Remove the fuel return manifold.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003500.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V; all production periods
##### Refitting
- Connect fuel return pipe from the fuel manfold pipe, fuel return manifold side, and tighten the collar.
- Connect the fuel return pipe from the pressure pump, fuel return manifold pipe side and tighten the band.
- Place the fuel return manifold pipe in its housing and secure it using the bolts.
- Connect the fuel return pipe from the injectors, fuel return manifold side.
- Connect the rapid connector for the fuel return pipe to the tank, fuel return manifold side.
Op. 1016A10 SOUND-PROOFING COVER - R.R [→939010416]

## 1060G70 VACUUM RESEVOIR - R.R  [939010572]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1060 DIESEL INJECTION SYSTEM > 1060G DIESEL INJECTION PRESSURE PUMP ELECTRONIC CONTROL > 1060G70 VACUUM RESEVOIR - R.R
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010572

##### Removing
Op. 1016A10 SOUND-PROOFING COVER - R.R [→939010416]
Op. 5530B10 BATTERY - R+R [→939011011]
1. Loosen the band and disconnect the engine oil vapour recovery pipe from the engine oil vapour separator.
2. Undo nuts securing the vacuum tank.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005653.jpg]

1. Disconnect the brake servo vacuum pipe rapid connector.
2. Open the clip and move the brake servo vacuum pipe to one side.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005654.jpg]

1. Undo the nut securing the duplex pipes to the thermostat.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005655.jpg]

1. Undo the nuts securing the duplex pipes to the starter motor and move them away.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005656.jpg]

- Disconnect the vacuum pipes from the vacuum tank and remove.

##### Refitting
- Place the vacuum tank back in its housing and secure it using the nuts.
- Connect the vacuum pipes to the vacuum tank.
- Connect the pipe to the oil vapour separator and secure it using the band.
- Place the duplex pipes back in their housing and secure them to the starter motor and thermostat with the nuts.
- Connect the rapid connector for the vacuum pump pipe and secure it with the retaining clips.
Op. 5530B10 BATTERY - R+R [→939011011]
Op. 1016A10 SOUND-PROOFING COVER - R.R [→939010416]

##### Refitting
- Place the system cable loom in its housing and secure it.
- Connect the earth lead to the alternator and secure it using the nut.
- Connect the electrical connection to the engine oil level sensor.
- Connect the electrical connection for the engine rpm sensor.
- Connect the electrical connection to the engine oil pressure warning light switch.
- Connect the earth lead to the starter motor and secure it using the nut.
- Connect the electrical connection to the fuel pressure regulator on the injector single manifold.
- Connect the electrical connection to the fuel pressure regulator on the pressure pump.
- Place the fuel return manifold pipe in its housing and secure it using the bolts.
- Place the electrical wiring in position and fasten it using the bolts.
- Connect the electrical connections to the injectors.
- Connect the electrical connection to the exhaust gas temperature sensor to the particle filter.
- Connect the electrical connection to the fuel pressure sensor.
- Connect the electrical connection to the throttle casing.
- Connect the electrical connection to the engine coolant temperature sensor.
- Connect the electrical connection for the pressure relief sensor.
- Connect the electrical connection to the E.G.R. solenoid valve.
- Connect the intermediate coupling for the cam angle sensor.
- Connect the electrical connections to the heater plugs control unit then place it in its housing and secure it using the nut.
- Connect the electrical connections to the heater plugs control unit.
- Connect the intermediate engine wiring coupling.
- Place the electrical wiring in position and fasten it to the bands.
- Connect the earth lead and tighten the nut.
- Connect the electrical connection to the air conditioning system multi-stage pressure switch.
- Connect the air conditioning compressor electrical connection.
- Connect the electrical connections to the diesel electronic injection system control unit.

1. Undo bolts (1a), (1b) and remove the catalytic converter bracket (1c).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001506.jpg]

1. Loosen collar (1a) and remove catalytic preconverter (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001507.jpg]

1. Loosen the collar and disconnect the air delivery sleeve between the turbocharger and the heat exchanger, turbocharger side.
2. Undo the bolts (2a) securing the engine oil return pipe from the turbocharger (2b), crankcase sump side.
3. Undo the connector (3a) securing the engine oil delivery pipe to the turbocharger (3b), crankcase side.
4. Disconnect the vacuum pipe from the variable geometry actuator.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001508.jpg]

1. Unscrew bolts (1a), loosen the band (1a) and remove the E.G.R. system water/exhaust gas heat exchanger inlet pipe (1c).
2. Remove the seals.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001509.jpg]

1. Undo the nuts (1a) and remove the turbocharger (1b).
2. Remove the seal.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001510.jpg]

1. Working at the bench, undo the bolts (1a) and remove the turbocharger engine oil return pipe (1b).
- Remove the seals.
2. Undo the connectors (2a) and remove the engine oil supply pipe to the turbocharger (2b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001511.jpg]

##### Refitting
1. Position the pipe carrying engine oil to the turbocharger (1a) in its housing and secure it tightening connectors (1b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Engine oil supply pipe to turbocharger | Connector | M10 | (turbocharger side) 1.5 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V 2.4 JTD 20V |
2. Position the engine oil return pipe from the turbocharger (2a) in its housing complete with gaskets and secure it by tightening bolts (2b) to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Engine oil supply pipe from turbocharger | Bolt | M8 | (turbocharger side) 2.3 - 2.8 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001512.jpg]

1. Place the gasket back in its housing.
2. Place turbocharger assembly (2a) in its housing and secure it by tightening the bolts (2b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Turbocharger and exhaust manifold assembly | Nut | M8 | (cylinder head side) 1.8 - 2.2 | 1.9 JTD 16V |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001513.jpg]

1. Refit the E.G.R. system water/exhaust gas heat exchanger inlet pipe (1a) with gaskets (1b), then secure with the collar and tighten bolts (1d) to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Exhaust gas/water heat exchanger for E.G.R. system | Bolt | M8 | (exhaust manifold side) 2.3 - 2.8 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V 2.4 JTD 20V |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001514.jpg]

1. Connect the vacuum pipe to the variable geometry actuator.
2. Tighten the connector (2a) securing the engine oil delivery pipe to the turbocharger (2b), crankcase side.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Engine oil supply pipe to turbocharger | Connector | M12 | (engine block side) 2.2 - 2.7 | 1.9 JTD 16V |
3. Tighten the bolts (3a) securing the engine oil return pipe from the turbocharger (3b), crankcase side, to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Engine oil supply pipe from turbocharger | Bolt | M8 | (engine block side) 2.2 - 2.7 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V |
4. Connect the air delivery sleeve between the turbocharger and the heat exchanger, turbocharger side, and tighten the collar.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001515.jpg]

1. Place the catalytic converter (1a) in its housing and secure it using the collar (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001516.jpg]

- Place the catalytic converter bracket in its housing and secure it using the bolts.

[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005660.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Place the turbocharger engine oil return pipe back in position and tighten the turbocharger-side bolts to the recommended torque.

| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Engine oil supply pipe to turbocharger | Connector | M10 | (turbocharger side) 1.5 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V 2.4 JTD 20V |
- Connect the catalytic converter to the turbocharger and fasten it using the collar.
- Tighten the nuts securing the exhaust manifold to the turbocharger to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Exhaust manifold | Nut | M8 | (turbocharger side) 2.3 - 2.8 | 2.4 JTD 20V |
- Fit a new gasket onto the exhaust manifold.
- Place the exhaust manifold complete with turbocharger and catalytic converter back in position and secure it to the cylinder head by tightening the nuts to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Exhaust manifold | Nut | M8 | (cylinder head side) 2.3 - 2.8 | 2.4 JTD 20V |
- Tighten the bolts securing the exhaust gas pipe for the E.G.R. to the recommended torque.

## 1064B42 SOLENOID CONTROLLING TURBOCHARGER VANE POSITION ACTUATOR - R.R  [939010582]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1064 ENGINE SUPERCHARGING SYSTEM > 1064B CONTROL/SAFETY DEVICES > 1064B42 SOLENOID CONTROLLING TURBOCHARGER VANE POSITION ACTUATOR - R.R
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010582

##### Removing
- Make sure that the ignition key is in the OFF position, then disconnect the battery terminal (-).
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| - | Battery | See A001 BATTERY [→939004879] |
1. Disconnect the electrical connection from the turbocharger vane actuator solenoid valve.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Turbine variable geometry control solenoid | See L036 TURBINE VARIABLE GEOMETRY CONTROL SOLENOID VALVE [→939004288] |
2. Disconnect the vacuum pipes from the turbocharger vane position actuator control solenoid valve.
3. Unscrew nuts (3a) and remove the turbocharger vane position actuator control solenoid valve (3b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001517.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Refit the turbocharger vane position actuator control solenoid valve and secure with nuts.
- Connect the vacuum pipes to the turbocharger vane position actuator control solenoid valve.
- Connect the electrical connection to the turbocharger vane actuator solenoid valve.
- Connect the negative battery terminal.

- Refit the electrical wiring and connect the engine wiring electrical connections to the glow plugs.

- Place the coolant return pipe to the engine coolant reservoir in position and tighten the bolts and collars.
- Place the fuel return manifold pipe in its housing and secure it using the bolts.
- Connect the fuel return pipes, fuel return manifold side, and tighten the collars.
- Refit the bracket with engine oil vapour separator and secure.
- Refit the rigid engine oil vapour recovery pipe section and secure with the bolts.
- Connect the rapid connector for the fuel return pipe to the tank, fuel return manifold side.
- Connect the condensate oil recovery pipe, engine oil vapour separator side, and tighten the band.
- Connect the engine oil vapour recovery pipes, engine oil vapour separator side, and tighten the collars.
- Refit the vacuum reservoir back in its housing and secure it using the nuts.
- Connect the vacuum pipes to the vacuum reservoir.

1. Undo the bolt fixing the lower coolant outlet hose from the radiator, air chamber side.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000380.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Loosen the band and disconnect the brake servo vacuum intake pipe, air chamber side.
2. Disconnect the electrical connection from the fuel vapour solenoid valve.

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Loosen the bands fixing the air chamber to the hoses.
2. Release the engine oil dipstick and remove it.
3. Undo the bolt securing the engine oil dipstick tube to the air chamber.
4. Undo the nut fixing the air chamber to the intake manifold.
5. Loosen the band and disconnect the engine oil vapour recovery pipe from the tappet cover.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000382.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Undo the bolt fixing the mounting bracket to the air chamber.

[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000384.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Refitting
- Place the air chamber back in its housing.
- Tighten the bolt fixing the mounting bracket to the air chamber.
- Connect the engine oil vapour recovery pipe to the tappet cover and tighten the band.
- Tighten the nut fixing the air chamber to the intake manifold.
- Tighten the bolt securing the engine oil dipstick tube to the air chamber.
- Place the engine oil dipstick back in its housing.
- Tighten the bands fixing the air chamber to the hoses.
- Connect the rapid connector for the fuel vapour pipe to the fuel vapour solenoid valve.
- Connect the electrical connection to the fuel vapour solenoid valve.
- Connect the brake servo vacuum intake pipe, air chamber side and tighten the band.
- Tighten the bolt fixing the lower coolant outlet hose from the radiator, air chamber side.

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and move the power assisted steering fluid reservoir (1b) sideways.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000386.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and disconnect the intermediate exhaust pipe (1b), exhaust manifold and catalytic converter side.

1. Support the power unit using a hydraulic hoist.

1. Undo the bolts (1a), (1b) and the flexible mounting for the timing side power unit front support (1c) complete with power assisted steering fluid reservoir mounting bracket (1d).

- Using the hydraulic hoist, tilt the power unit forwards, as necessary, to extract the exhaust manifold and catalytic converter.

[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000392.jpg]

- Remove the hydraulic hoist used to support the power unit.
1. Tighten the bolts fixing the exhaust manifold and catalytic converter to the mounting bracket.

| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Intermediate exhaust pipe with flexible section | Bolt | M8 | (exhaust manifold side with catalytic converter) 2.2 - 2.6 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |

## 1076B22 REAR EXHAUST SILENCERS (ONE) LH OR RH R R  [939010608]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1076 EXHAUST PIPES AND SILENCERS > 1076B EXHAUST PIPES AND SILENCERS > 1076B22 REAR EXHAUST SILENCERS (ONE) LH OR RH R R

##### Removing
- Position the vehicle on a lift.
1. Loosen the collars securing the rear exhaust silencers to the front exhaust silencer.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000402.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Remove the rear exhaust silencers releasing them from the flexible mountings and from the front exhaust silencer.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000403.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Refitting
- Place the rear exhaust silencers in their housings and secure them to the flexible supports.
- Tighten the collars securing the rear exhaust silencers to the front exhaust silencer.
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.

> Block applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Removing
- Position the vehicle on a lift.
1. Loosen the collar fastening the front silencer to the catalyzer assembly.
2. Release the rear silencers (2b) from the flexible mountings (2a).
3. Release the silencer assembly (3b) from the flexible mountings (3a) and remove it.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946000367.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Loosen the collars (1a) and remove the exhaust silencers (1b) from the front exhaust silencer pipe.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946000368.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 3.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Refitting
- Attach the two rear exhaust silencers to the front silencer pipe and secure them using the collars.
- Place the silencer assembly in position, attaching the front exhaust silencer to the catalyzer assembly and connecting the flexible support mountings.
- Tighten the collar connecting the front silencer to the catalyzer assembly.
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.

## 1080A20 EXHAUST FUMES - CHECK WITH OPACIMETER  [939010615]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1080 EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEM > 1080A EMISSION CHECKS AND ADJUSTMENTS > 1080A20 EXHAUST FUMES - CHECK WITH OPACIMETER
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010615

- Start the car and let it warm up until the radiator cooling fan has come on twice.
> Note: Leave as little time as possible before starting the test once the engine is warm and avoid leaving the engine to idle for long periods.
> Note: Check that the probe diameter is at least 0.22 times the diameter of the exhaust pipe.
> Note: Ensure that the exhaust gas intake fittings do not allow leaks.
- Position the fume meter measurement probe in the end of the exhaust pipe, ensuring that its end is positioned in a pipe section where the gas flow is evenly distributed.
- If necessary, to meet the above requirements, apply an extension to the exhaust pipe so that the coupling to the exhaust pipe is sealed and the end of the probe is positioned in a long straight section towards the engine that is at least six times the tailpipe diameter and at least three times the tailpipe diameter downstream.
> Note: Check that the probe intake pipe from the tailpipe to the fume meter is on an ascending gradient without any sharply angled joints.
> Note: Ensure the counterpressure at the probe is as specified and does not exceed 7.5 bars during the test.
- With the engine running at idle speed, place the gearbox in neutral and release the clutch pedal.
- Position the fume metre so that exhaust gas can be drawn off.
- Take the reading shown by the fume metre pointer.
- As the engine is idling, operate the accelerator pedal quickly but smoothly until the engine is running at maximum rpm and the regulator cuts in.
- Record and note down the maximum fume level indicated by the fume meter during acceleration without taking values during the release stage into account.
- Once maximum rotation speed has been achieved, release the accelerator control until the engine resumes idling.
- Check that the fume meter pointer returns to the position measured previously at idle speed.
- Repeat the above operations at least six times until the fume readings stabilise.
> Note: The readings may be considered stable when they are within a band that is 0.25 m-1 wide for four consecutive readings and not in decreasing order.
- The fume value to be considered is the arithmetic mean of the four stabilised values.
- Check that the fume level imeets the required value stamped on the vehicle marking summary plate located in the engine compartment and indicated in the following table.

## 1080A10 IDLING C.O. LEVEL - CHECK WITH SPECIAL EQUIPMENT  [939010616]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1080 EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEM > 1080A EMISSION CHECKS AND ADJUSTMENTS > 1080A10 IDLING C.O. LEVEL - CHECK WITH SPECIAL EQUIPMENT
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.8, 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS, 3.2 JTS; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010616

> Note: Carry out the measurement with all the emission control devices active and at the specified idle speed.
- Insert the probe of an exhaust gas analyser into the end of the exhaust pipe for at least 30 cm.
> Note: If the shape of the exhaust tailpipe will not allow the probe to be fully introduced, add an extension that ensures a seal in the joint area.
- Wait for the exhaust gas tester indices to stabilise.
- With the engine idling, check that the CO2 level is within specified limits.

1. Loosen the collar (1a) securing the front silencer (1b) to the catalyzer assembly.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946001180.jpg]

1. Undo the nuts securing the left exhaust pipe to the catalytic converter.
2. Undo the nuts securing the right exhaust pipe to the catalytic converter.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/946001181.jpg]

- Remove the catalytic converter assembly from the front silencer.
- If necessary, undo the rear Lambda sensors and remove them.

##### Refitting
- Place the rear Lambda sensors in their housings and tighten them to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Right rear Lambda sensor | - | M18 | 4.1 ÷ 5.0 |  |
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Left rear Lambda sensor | - | M18 | 4.1 ÷ 5.0 |  |
- Place the catalytic converter assembly in its housing and connect it to the front silencer.
- Tighten the nuts securing the right exhaust pipe to the catalytic converter.
- Tighten the nuts securing the left exhaust pipe to the catalytic converter.
- Tighten the collar securing the front silencer to the catalyzer assembly.
- Connect the electrical connections for the rear Lambda sensors.
- Place the protection for the rear Lambda sensor connections in its housing and tighten the fastenings.
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.

1. Unscrew the bolts (1a) securing the bracket (1b) to the catalytic converter.

| Thermal coupling signalling catalytic converter overheating | - | M14 | (catalytic converter side) 4.5 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V 2.4 JTD 20V |
- Place the exhaust pipe, complete with new gasket, back in its housing and secure it to the catalytic converter tightening the nuts to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Intermediate exhaust pipe with flexible section | Nuts | M8 | (catalytic converter side) 2.2 - 2.6 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V 2.4 JTD 20V |
- Tighten the bolt securing the exhaust pipe to the engine oil sump.
- Tighten the bolt securing the catalytic converter mounting bracket to the engine oil sump.
- Tighten the bolts securing the catalyzer mounting bracket to the catalytic converter.

## 1080B81 PARTICULATE FILTER (D.P.F.) - R R  [939010625]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1080 EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEM > 1080B EXHAUST EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEM > 1080B81 PARTICULATE FILTER (D.P.F.) - R R
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010625

##### Removing
> Note: If the particulate filter (DPF) is replaced, reset using an examiner after refitting.
- Position the vehicle on a lift.
1. Undo bolts (1a), nuts (1b) and remove the particulate filter bracket (1c).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001546.jpg]

1. Loosen the collars and disconnect the hoses from the rigid pipes for the particulate filter differential pressure sensor.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001547.jpg]

1. Unscrew the exhaust gas temperature sensor on the particulate filter and remove.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001548.jpg]

1. Loosen collar (1a), unscrew nuts (1b) and remove the particulate filter (1c) complete with gasket.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001549.jpg]

1. Working at the bench, unscrew connector (1a) and remove the pressure intake pipe downstream of the particulate filter (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001550.jpg]

##### Refitting
1. Refit the pressure intake pipe downstream of particulate filter (1a) and tighten connector (1b) to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pressure intake pipe downstream of particle filter | Connector | M8 | (D.P.F. particle filter side) 1.2 - 1.6 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V 2.4 JTD 20V |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001551.jpg]

1. Refit particulate filter (1a) with its gasket, then tighten collar (1b) and nuts (1c) to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Intermediate exhaust pipe with flexible section | Nuts | M8 | (D.P.F. particle filter side) 1.2 - 2.6 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V 2.4 JTD 20V |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001552.jpg]

1. Place the exhaust gas temperature sensor in its housing on the particulate filter and tighten it to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Exhaust gas temperature sensor on particle filter | - | M14 | (D.P.F. particle filter side) 4.5 | 1.9 JTD 8V 1.9 JTD 16V 2.4 JTD 20V |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939001553.jpg]

- Connect the hoses to the rigid pipes for the particulate filter differential pressure sensor and tighten the collars.
- Place the particulate filter bracket in its housing and secure it using the bolts.
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.
