## 1084B18 ENGINE OIL PUMP, REMOVED - CHECK AT BENCH  [939010655]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1084 ENGINE LUBRICATION > 1084B ENGINE OIL LUBRICATION CIRCUIT > 1084B18 ENGINE OIL PUMP, REMOVED - CHECK AT BENCH
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: all engines; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010655

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Removing
1. Undo the cap (1a) and remove the engine oil pressure relief valve (1b).
2. Undo the bolts (2a) and remove the pump cover (2b).
3. Remove the drive gear.
4. Remove the driven gear.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939003533.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Refitting
- Check that the radial clearance between the driven gear and the pump casing is within the recommended limits; if this is not the case, replace the oil pump assembly.
| Measurement | Value | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Radial clearance between pump casing and driven gear | 0.314 mm | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939003534.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Place the engine oil pump cover back in its housing and secure it using the bolts.
> Note: Manually rotate the gear to check that it does not stick.
- Place the oil pressure relief valve in position and tighten the cap.

> Block applies to: engines: 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
##### Removing
Position the engine oil pump in the vice fitted with protective jaws.
1. Fit the tool.
|  | Description | Code | Function |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Counter-torque/Template | 1.870.799.000 | Oil pump timing |
2. Undo the (left hand0 bolt (2a) and remove the oil pump drive chain assembly (2b).
Remove the tool.
|  | Description | Code | Function |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| . | Counter-torque/Template | 1.870.799.000 | Oil pump timing |

2. Fit the inner rotor (2a) positioning the guide seal (2b) on the marked surface (2c) inside the housing (2d) on the pump casing.

## 1084B34 CARTRIDGE ENGINE OIL FILTER SUPPORT - R + R  [939010658]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1084 ENGINE LUBRICATION > 1084B ENGINE OIL LUBRICATION CIRCUIT > 1084B34 CARTRIDGE ENGINE OIL FILTER SUPPORT - R + R
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010658

##### Removing
- Position the vehicle on a lift.
- Make sure that the ignition key is in the OFF position, then disconnect the battery terminal (-).
Op. 7055B54 UNDER ENGINE PROTECTION/GUARD - R.R. [→939011369]
Op. 1084A16 OIL DIPSTICK PIPE - R.R [→939010644]
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and disconnect the engine oil supply and return pipe (1b), engine oil filter mounting side.
> Note: Collect the engine oil that comes out in a suitable container.
2. Disconnect the electrical connection from the engine oil pressure warning light switch.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | Insufficient engine oil pressure sensor (switch) | See K030 LOW ENGINE OIL PRESSURE SENSOR (SWITCH) [→939004179] |
3. Loosen the band and disconnect the oil return pipe to the sump, cartridge engine oil filter mounting side.
4. Undo the bolts (4a) and remove the cartridge engine oil filter mounting (4b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939003535.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Place the cartridge engine oil filter mounting in its housing and secure it tightening the bolts to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Engine oil filter mounting | Bolt | M20 | (engine block side) 3.6 | 2.4 JTD 20V |
- Connect the oil return pipe to the sump, cartridge engine oil filter mounting side and tighten the band.
- Connect the electrical connection to the engine oil pressure warning light switch.
- Connect the engine oil supply and return pipes, engine oil filter mounting side and secure them using the bolts.
Op. 1084A16 OIL DIPSTICK PIPE - R.R [→939010644]
- Connect the negative battery terminal.
Op. 0010T11 ENGINE OIL - CHECK LEVEL AND TOP UP, IF NECESSARY [→939010367]
Op. 7055B54 UNDER ENGINE PROTECTION/GUARD - R.R. [→939011369]
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.

## 1088B35 LOWER PIN SUPPORTING ENGINE COOLING RADIATOR (ONE), LH OR RH - R&R  [939005288]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1088 ENGINE COOLING > 1088B ENGINE COOLING RADIATOR > 1088B35 LOWER PIN SUPPORTING ENGINE COOLING RADIATOR (ONE), LH OR RH - R&R
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS, 3.2 JTS, 1.9 JTD 8V, 1.9 JTD 16V, 2.4 JTD 20V; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939005288

##### Removing
- Position the vehicle on a lift.
1. Loosen the bolt (1a) and undo the bolt (1b) and remove the front bumper mounting bracket (1c).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005208.jpg]

1. Undo the bolt securing the air duct to the radiator.
2. Loosen the bolt (2a), undo the bolt (2b) and remove the radiator mounting bracket (2c) complete with flexible mounting and lower radiator support pin.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005209.jpg]

##### Refitting
1. Fit the new radiator support pin in its housing until the retaining clip clicks into place.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005210.jpg]

- Fit the flexible mounting on the lower radiator support pin.
- Tighten the bolt securing the air duct to the radiator.
- Place the radiator mounting bracket complete with the flexible mounting in its housing and secure it using the bolts.
- Place the bumper mounting bracket in its housing and secure it using the bolts.
- Connect the bumper to the bracket fitted previously.
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.

##### Removing

1. Undo the coolant drain plug in the water pump and drain the coolant.
> Note: Collect the coolant in a suitable container.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000435.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Disconnect the electrical connection from the engine coolant temperature sensor.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |

2. Loosen the collar and disconnect the upper coolant input sleeve to the radiator, thermostat side.
3. Loosen the bands and disconnect the coolant delivery and return pipes to the climate control system heater, thermostat side.
4. Undo the engine coolant temperature sensor and remove it.
> Note: The engine coolant temperature sensor is removed to gain access to one of the thermostat fixing bolts.
5. Undo the bolts (5a) and remove the thermostat (5b) complete with water pump rigid fluid inlet pipe (5c) and O-rings (5d).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000436.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods

[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000437.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the water pump service cover (1b) from the timing chain cover.
2. Remove the gasket.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000438.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
1. Fit the tool (1a) for securing the water pump drive pulley and fasten with two bolts (1b) to the timing chain cover and with three bolts (1c) to the water pump drive pulley.
| Tool | Description | Function | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2000001200 | Flange | Locking water pump pulley | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
2. Undo the three bolts fixing the drive pulley to the water pump.
3. Undo the two bolts fixing the water pump to the engine block.
> Note: The lower bolt should not be extracted on account of its length.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000439.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods

[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000440.jpg]

> Block applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
##### Refitting

## 1088C30 THERMOSTAT UNIT - R+R  [939010676]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1088 ENGINE COOLING > 1088C WATER PUMP AND THERMOSTAT > 1088C30 THERMOSTAT UNIT - R+R
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010676

##### Removing
- Position the vehicle on a lift.
Op. 5530B10 BATTERY - R+R [→939011011]
Op. 5530B52 BATTERY SUPPORT/DRIP TRAY - R.R [→939011009]
1. Undo the radiator coolant drain plug.
> Note: Collect the coolant in a suitable container.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000445.jpg]

1. Disconnect the electrical connection from the engine coolant temperature sensor.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Engine coolant temperature sensor/sender unit | See K036 ENGINE COOLANT TEMPERATURE SENSOR/SENDER UNIT [→939004185] |
2. Loosen the collar and disconnect the upper coolant input sleeve to the radiator, thermostat side.
3. Loosen the band and disconnect the coolant return pipe from the climate control system heater, thermostat side.
4. Loosen the band and disconnect the coolant supply pipe to the heat exchanger, thermostat side.
5. Undo the engine coolant temperature sensor and remove it.
> Note: The engine coolant temperature sensor is removed to gain access to one of the thermostat fixing bolts.
6. Undo the bolts (6a) and remove the thermostat (6b) complete with water pump rigid fluid inlet pipe (6c) and O-rings (6d).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000446.jpg]

1. At the bench, separate the thermostat (1a) from the water pump rigid fluid inlet pipe (1b).
2. Remove the seal.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000447.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Assemble the rigid coolant inlet pipe and water pump complete with a new seal.
1. Place the thermostat (1a) complete with water pump rigid coolant inlet pipe (1b) and new O-rings (1c) back in its housing and secure it tightening the bolts (1d) to the recommended torque.
> Note: Apply (white) silicon grease to the O-rings.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Thermostat unit | Bolt | M6 | (engine block side) 0.6 - 1.0 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
2. Place the engine coolant temperature sensor in its housing and tighten it to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Engine coolant temperature sensor | - | M12 | (thermostat unit side) 2.2 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS 3.2 JTS |
3. Connect the coolant supply pipe to the heat exchanger, thermostat side, and tighten the band.
4. Connect the coolant return pipe from the climate control system heater, thermostat side, and tighten the band.
5. Connect the upper coolant input sleeve to the radiator, thermostat side, and tighten the band.
6. Connect the electrical connection to the engine coolant temperature sensor.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000448.jpg]

- Tighten the coolant drain plug to the radiator.
Op. 5530B52 BATTERY SUPPORT/DRIP TRAY - R.R [→939011009]
Op. 5530B10 BATTERY - R+R [→939011011]
Op. 0010T20 ENGINE COOLANT - CHANGE [→939010369]
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.

## 1088D56 ENGINE OIL HEAT EXCHANGER DELIVERY AND RETURN DUPLEX RIGID PIPING - R R  [939010689]

- Position the vehicle on a lift.

1. Undo the radiator coolant drain plug.
> Note: Collect the coolant in a suitable container.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003676.jpg]

1. Loosen the band and disconnect the air supply hose from the rigid intermediate pipe to the rigid pipe on the throttle casing.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003677.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the rigid air inlet pipe on the throttle casing (1b) complete with hose (1c).
2. Loosen the band and disconnect the upper coolant inlet hose to the radiator, thermostat side.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003678.jpg]

1. Undo the bolt (1a) and the nut (1b) securing the water pump rigid intermediate supply pipe.
2. Loosen the band (2a) and move the water pump supply pipe (2b) to the side.
3. Loosen the band and disconnect the coolant delivery pipe from the coolant/exhaust gas heat exchanger for the EGR system, water pump rigid inlet pipe side.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003679.jpg]

1. Loosen the band and disconnect the coolant supply pipe to the engine oil heat exchanger, thermostat side.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003680.jpg]

1. Disconnect the electrical connection from the engine oil pressure warning light switch.
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Insufficient engine oil pressure sensor (switch) | See K030 LOW ENGINE OIL PRESSURE SENSOR (SWITCH) [→939004179] |
2. Loosen the bands and disconnect the engine coolant inlet and outlet pipes from the engine oil heat exchanger.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003681.jpg]

1. Undo the nuts fixing the duplex rigid engine oil heat exchanger supply and return pipe to the starter motor bracket.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003682.jpg]

1. Remove the duplex engine oil heat exchanger rigid supply and return pipe complete with flexible hoses.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/194003683.jpg]

##### Refitting
- Place the duplex engine oil heat exchanger rigid supply and return pipe back in its housing complete with flexible hoses.
- Tighten the nuts fixing the duplex rigid engine oil heat exchanger supply and return pipe to the starter motor bracket.
- Connect the engine coolant inlet and outlet pipes to the engine oil heat exchanger and tighten the bands.
- Connect the electrical connection to the engine oil pressure warning light switch.
- Connect the coolant supply pipe to the engine oil heat exchanger, thermostat side, and tighten the band.
- Connect the coolant delivery pipe from the coolant/exhaust gas heat exchanger for the EGR system, water pump rigid inlet pipe side and tighten the band.
- Place the water pump supply pipe in its housing, connect it and tighten the band.
- Tighten the bolt and the nut securing the water pump rigid intermediate supply pipe.
- Connect the radiator upper coolant inlet hose, thermostat side, and tighten the band.
- Place the throttle casing rigid air inlet pipe in its housing complete with hose and tighten the bolts and the band.
- Tighten the coolant drain plug to the radiator.

## 1092B91 WATER PUMP BALANCING SHAFT DRIVE CHAIN GEARS AND COMPONENTS R R  [939010698]
- Path: Procedures > 10 ENGINE > 1092 ENGINE COMPONENT MISCELLANEOUS DRIVES > 1092B WATER PUMP AND ALTERNATOR DRIVE > 1092B91 WATER PUMP BALANCING SHAFT DRIVE CHAIN GEARS AND COMPONENTS R R
- Kind: repair procedure (removal / refitting, operation number = code)
- Applies to: engines: 1.9 JTS, 2.2 JTS; all production periods
- Web: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/#/939010698

##### Removing
- Position the vehicle on a lift.
- Make sure that the ignition key is in the OFF position, then disconnect the battery terminal (-).
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| - | Battery | See A001 BATTERY [→939004879] |
Op. 4450B04 RIGHT FRONT WHEEL - R.R [→939010872]
Op. 7055B66 ENGINE COMPARTMENT DUST COVER IN RIGHT FRONT WHEEL ARCH - R.R. [→939004938]
Op. 1032A12 TIMING SYSTEM DRIVE CHAIN - R.R [→939010456]
1. Remove the timing drive pulley.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000463.jpg]

1. Unscrew the bolts (1a) and remove the water pump/balancer shaft drive chain hydraulic tensioner.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000464.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the chain tensioner pads (1b).
2. Remove the water pump/balancing shafts drive chain.
3. Remove the water pump/balancing shafts drive chain pulley.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000465.jpg]

1. Using a suitable tool for counter-torque, undo the water pump drive gear fixing bolts.
2. Remove the water pump drive gear.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000466.jpg]

1. Fit the tool (1a) using the bolt (1b) for securing it (it is the bolt fixing the counter-balance shaft flange).
| Tool | Description | Function | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2000000600 | Counter-torque | Loosen/ tighten bolts securing the counter-balance shaft drive pulley | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
2. Undo the bolt (2a) and remove the inlet side counter-balance shaft drive pulley (2b).
> Note: This pulley has the words "INTAKE" and "GREEN" stamped on it so that it is correctly refitted.
- Carry out the same operations for the exhaust side counter-balance shaft drive pulley.
> Note: This pulley has the words "EXHAUST" and "WHITE" stamped on it so that it is correctly refitted.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000467.jpg]

##### Refitting
1. Position the inlet side counter-balance shaft drive pulley (1a) in its housing and secure it tightening the bolt (1b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Counter-balance shaft drive pullies | Bolt | M10 | (counter-balance shafts side) 0.7 - 0.9 + 30° | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
2. Remove the tool used for counter-torque.
| Tool | Description | Function | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2000000600 | Counter-torque | Loosen/ tighten bolts securing the counter-balance shaft drive pulley | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
- Tighten the bolt fixing the counter-balance shaft flange to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Counter balance shafts | Bolt | M6 | (engine block side) 0.7 - 0.9 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
- Carry out the same operations for the exhaust side counter-balance shaft drive pulley.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000468.jpg]

1. Place the water pump drive gear back in its housing.
2. Using a suitable tool for counter-torque, tighten the bolts fixing the water pump drive gear to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Water pump drive pulley | Bolt | M6 | (water pump side) 0.8 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000469.jpg]

- Place the water pump/balancing shafts drive chain pulley in its housing.
> Note: Take care over the fitting position.
1. Place the water pump/balancing shafts drive chain in its housing.
> Note: The copper mesh (a) should be aligned with the arrow stamped on the inlet side balancing shaft drive pulley; the silver mesh (b) should be aligned with the reference C-R stamped on the drive pulley; the silver mesh (c) should be aligned with the arrow stamped on the exhaust side balancing shaft drive pulley.
2. Place the chain tensioner pads (2a) in their housing and secure it by tightening the bolts (2b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Water pump/balancing shafts drive chain pad(s) | Bolt | M6 | (engine block side) 0.7 - 0.9 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000470.jpg]

1. Fit a suitable pin (diameter 1.5 mm) to secure the counterrotating shaft and water pump drive chain tensioner.
> Note: Press the tensioner piston and turn to the right to fit the pin.
2. Refit the water pump/balancer shaft drive chain hydraulic tensioner (2a) and secure by tightening bolts (2b) to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Water pump/balancing shafts drive chain hydraulic tensioner | Bolt | M6 | (engine block side) 0.7 - 0.9 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
- Remove the pin locking the counter-rotating shaft and water pump drive chain tensioner.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000471.jpg]

- Place the timing drive chain pulley in its housing.
> Note: Take care over the fitting position.
Op. 1032A12 TIMING SYSTEM DRIVE CHAIN - R.R [→939010456]
Op. 7055B66 ENGINE COMPARTMENT DUST COVER IN RIGHT FRONT WHEEL ARCH - R.R. [→939004938]
Op. 4450B04 RIGHT FRONT WHEEL - R.R [→939010872]
- Connect the negative battery terminal.
Op. 0010T11 ENGINE OIL - CHECK LEVEL AND TOP UP, IF NECESSARY [→939010367]
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.

- Position the vehicle on a lift.
- Make sure that the ignition key is in the OFF position, then disconnect the battery terminal (-).
|  | Description | Connector |
| --- | --- | --- |
| - | Battery | See A001 BATTERY [→939004879] |
Op. 4450B04 RIGHT FRONT WHEEL - R.R [→939010872]
Op. 7055B66 ENGINE COMPARTMENT DUST COVER IN RIGHT FRONT WHEEL ARCH - R.R. [→939004938]
Op. 1032A12 TIMING SYSTEM DRIVE CHAIN - R.R [→939010456]
1. Remove the timing drive pulley.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000474.jpg]

1. Unscrew the bolts (1a) and remove the water pump/balancer shaft drive chain hydraulic tensioner.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000475.jpg]

1. Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the chain tensioner pads (1b).
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000476.jpg]

##### Refitting
1. Place the chain tensioner pads (1a) in their housings and secure them tightening the bolts (1b) to the recommended torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Water pump/balancing shafts drive chain pad(s) | Bolt | M6 | (engine block side) 0.7 - 0.9 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939000477.jpg]

1. Fit a suitable pin (diameter 1.5 mm) to secure the counterrotating shaft and water pump drive chain tensioner.
> Note: Press the tensioner piston and turn to the right to fit the tool.
2. Refit the water pump/balancer shaft drive chain hydraulic tensioner (2a) and secure by tightening bolts (2b) to the specified torque.
| Component | Fastening | dia | Value (daNm) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Water pump/balancing shafts drive chain hydraulic tensioner | Bolt | M6 | (engine block side) 0.7 - 0.9 | 1.9 JTS 2.2 JTS |
- Remove the pin locking the counter-rotating shaft and water pump drive chain tensioner.
[image: https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/media/939005690.jpg]

- Place the timing drive chain pulley in its housing.
> Note: Take care over the fitting position.
Op. 1032A12 TIMING SYSTEM DRIVE CHAIN - R.R [→939010456]
Op. 7055B66 ENGINE COMPARTMENT DUST COVER IN RIGHT FRONT WHEEL ARCH - R.R. [→939004938]
Op. 4450B04 RIGHT FRONT WHEEL - R.R [→939010872]
- Connect the negative battery terminal.
Op. 0010T11 ENGINE OIL - CHECK LEVEL AND TOP UP, IF NECESSARY [→939010367]
- Remove the vehicle from the lift.
